recipe.techniqueInstruction: balanced small-dose pulses: center start, low stream, keep water off the paper walls.

prepSteps.action: Rinse and preheat the V60 02 filter and server; discard rinse water.
Add 15g coffee, settle, and level the bed.

steps.action: Bloom with 50g from the center. Wet the entire bed, then gently swirl at 0:10 and rest until 0:45.
steps.name: Bloom & swirl

steps.action: Pour in a controlled spiral to 100g by 1:00, keeping the stream low and off the paper.
steps.name: Pour 1

steps.action: Pause until 1:10.
steps.name: Rest

steps.action: Pour in the same controlled spiral to 150g by 1:20.
steps.name: Pour 2

steps.action: Pause until 1:30.
steps.name: Rest

steps.action: Pour to 200g by 1:40.
steps.name: Pour 3

steps.action: Pause until 1:50.
steps.name: Rest

steps.action: Pour to 250g by 2:00.
steps.name: Final pour

steps.action: Give the brewer one gentle swirl to level the bed, then let it draw down.
steps.name: Swirl & draw down

sourceLineage.adaptation: Published method: James Hoffmann — one-cup V60 with a bean-specific temperature adjustment.

recipe.reasoning: This coffee suits a balanced small-dose pulse pattern for clarity, sweetness, and repeatability.
recipe.tips: Finish when the steady stream slows to occasional drips. Save the actual drawdown; taste decides what to change next time.
recipe.title: V60 02 recipe for this bean

recipe.techniqueInstruction: pulse-driven 67/33 flash brew: brew hot directly over ice for rapid cooling; serving ice is separate.

prepSteps.action: Rinse and preheat the V60 02 filter and server; discard rinse water.
Add 75g brew ice to the server. This is recipe water, not a measured melt guarantee.
Add 15g coffee and level the bed.

steps.action: Bloom with 45g from the center; wet the bed evenly and do not swirl.
Pulse in a restrained center-to-small-spiral pattern to 75g; keep off paper.
Finish with a low centered pulse to 150g; keep the stream on the bed and away from paper. After drawdown give the gentle carafe swirl from the source.

postBrewSteps.action: After drawdown, give the gentle carafe swirl from the source.

sourceLineage.adaptation: Independent iced profile based on Partners Coffee; hot candidate is not used.

recipe.reasoning: This iced profile uses the pulse-67-33 extraction budget for a single cup 12 20 dose.
recipe.tips: Guide finish 2:50 ends at drawdown. Chilling happens after Finish Brew and is not timing memory.
recipe.title: Iced V60 02 bean-specific recipe
